_comment: Example profile. Copy to ~/.config/asbx/profiles/ and edit - your real hosts and secret paths belong there, not in version control.

capabilities.label: admin API

when._comment_methods: POST is not a write here: /__admin/requests/find is a search. Method is a poor proxy for danger on this API, so the deny list below carries the weight.
when._comment_deny: A shared WireMock is shared with other people. These endpoints hit all of them: reset clears the whole request journal, mappings/reset drops every stub, shutdown stops the server. Scoped deletes (requests/remove with a RequestPattern) stay available.

capabilities._comment_secret: pass: keeps credentials in the store you already back up. keychain:SERVICE:ACCOUNT works too - or the explicit form, {"backend": "pass", "entry": "wiremock/developer"}.
capabilities._comment_injection: username.guest_env mirrors username.value into the guest's plain environment (here, WIREMOCK_USER) so a tool inside the guest can build a matching Basic-auth header - the value is written once, not once per place it's needed.
